title: Round Number Preferences and Left-Digit Bias: Evidence from Credit Card Repayments
authors: Hiroaki Sakaguchi; John Gathergood; Neil Stewart
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Regression-discontinuity designs on credit-card statements: repayment outcomes (round-number payment dummies, log repayment) regressed on before/after indicators and polynomials in the distance h to a round-number threshold of the minimum payment or of the balance (feols/felm, two-way clustered by AccountNumber and Cycle, no fixed effects). Table A6-A9 regress repayment on high-order polynomials of the minimum payment. The package ships only a mock dataset.
design_notes: R (fixest, lfe); codes/script_A.R ... script_M.R, data built from data/data_0.csv by create_data_*.R. Main Tables 1-4 (script_B, script_C): before:h + after:h + after polynomial RD specifications.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: RD on minimum-payment / balance thresholds; no treatment adoption over time, no unit or time FE

data_files_note: README: 'data_0.csv is a minimum mock data file' (240,000 rows); folder named 'Code and Simulated Data'. Original UK credit card data are proprietary.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). code_prescore 2 likely triggered by before/after terms of the RD.
